items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: we made this picture that featured our band in a moving picture that was made with Noah Beery Jr.

ctx.x: Unfortunately he had some bad luck, physical handicaps, and later on he -- well, the band didn't stay together too long either. We came to Hollywood and we played Billy Berg's for a short period, and then we made this picture that featured our band in a moving picture that was made with Noah Beery Jr., and some other people. I think the name of the picture was the "Crimson Canary Murder Case".
